name: Stereotaxis
description: Stereotaxis, Inc. (NYSE American: STXS) is a medical robotics company founded in 1990 and headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, United States. The company develops Robotic Magnetic Navigation (RMN) systems—including the [Niobe](/robot/stereotaxis_niobe), [Genesis RMN](/robot/stereotaxis_genesis), and GenesisX platforms—that use dual computer-controlled permanent magnets positioned on either side of the fluoroscopy table to steer magnet-tipped catheters inside the heart and vasculature during cardiac electrophysiology ablation and endovascular procedures. In July 2026, Stereotaxis completed the acquisition of French vascular robotics developer [Robocath](/company/robocath), adding the mechanical [R-One](/robot/robocath_r_one) percutaneous coronary intervention platform to its portfolio.
